Connect the App Store, Google Play or Stripe with its credentials, or add a payment source. Run it
again to change a store's settings: values not given keep what is saved.

Usage:
  voidhash provider connect <command> [flags]

Commands:
  app-store       Connect the App Store with the app's ids and keys.
  google-play     Connect Google Play with the app's package name and a service account key.
  stripe          Connect Stripe with your account id, API keys and webhook secrets.
  payment-source  Add a payment source: payments taken outside the stores.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash provider connect <command> --help' for more about a command.
